    • columnWidths

      public Columns.Builder columnWidths(Constraint... widths)
      Sets the width constraints for columns.

      If not set, all columns use Constraint.fill(). If fewer constraints than columns are provided, remaining columns use Constraint.fill().

      Parameters:
      widths - the column width constraints
      Returns:
      this builder

    • rowHeights

      public Columns.Builder rowHeights(int... heights)
      Sets explicit row heights.

      If not set, rows share the available height equally. If fewer heights than rows are provided, remaining rows default to 1.

      Parameters:
      heights - the row heights
      Returns:
      this builder
